The '''spukami''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Cat/Legends|housecat]] with [[Color/Legends|black]] fur and golden [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Individual spukami were sometimes called '''spukamas'''. Spukami were unusually intelligent, though non-sentient, and were popular as pets. They could be taught simple commands, but, either out of boredom or stubbornness, only obeyed them about two-thirds of the time. They were adept at catching and killing small vermin with their sharp teeth and claws, but when bored, often chewed at whatever bits of [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]] or cloth were at hand. The spukamas was a solitary creature and would lash out violently at any other spukamas it encountered in its territory; pet owners could only keep one at a time.<ref name="CO">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
